title: Entity search results
responsibility: Shows ranked entity links inside the project search modal.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.id
inputs.description: Required list ID and prefix for indexed option IDs.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.found
inputs.description: Required results in supplied order, with category, name, purpose and identity.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.active
inputs.description: Required zero-based active position for aria-selected; an out-of-range value selects none.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.loading
inputs.description: Required flag showing Loading entities regardless of current result count.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.query
inputs.description: Required query text used in the empty-result message.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.scope
inputs.description: Required human-readable revision/search scope displayed above results.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.href
inputs.description: Required callback supplying each result’s actual link target.

inputs.name: EntitySearchResults.choose
inputs.description: Required callback for ordinary primary-button clicks. Modified or other-button clicks retain native link behavior.

outputs.name: EntitySearchResults
outputs.description: A scrollable list of ranked entity links, their categories and purposes, with loading or no-match feedback. Modified clicks preserve normal browser link behavior.
